info.title: Agora Feedback API
info.description: M4a backend. One review per immutable (orderId,skuId) paid line verified by Commerce. Same normalized create payload replays with 200; different content conflicts with 409. Strict JSON up to 16384 UTF-8 bytes; unknown/duplicate fields and query parameters rejected. Admin moderation requires a reason for hide and restore. Public responses exclude buyer/order/SKU/moderation data. IPN/provider acceptance deferred to deployment; no payment bypass.
